mechanics.claim: In Human Form, Elise gains one dormant Spiderling per ability cast that hits an enemy, up to the cap.
mechanics.quote: '''Elise''' gains one dormant ''Spiderling'' whenever she hits an enemy with an {{tip|ability}}, storing once per cast and up to {{pp|type = [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=]] ''Human Form's'' Rank|2 to 5 for 4}} at a time.

mechanics.claim: Elise starts the game and each respawn with the maximum number of Spiderlings already stored.
mechanics.quote: She stores the maximum number of ''Spiderlings'' when the game starts and upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.

mechanics.claim: Spider Form's bonus on-hit damage does not affect structures.
mechanics.quote: ''Spider Form's'' effects do not apply to {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: The Spider Form bonus damage on-hit applies as proc damage (a separate damage instance) alongside the basic attack, which itself can still crit and apply other on-hit effects normally.
mechanics.quote: ''Spider Form's'' basic attacks will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the '''bonus''' damage does not).

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage can be blocked or dodged, and does not apply if Elise is blinded.
mechanics.quote: ''Spider Form's'' bonus damage and healing can be {{tip|blocked}}, {{tip|dodge}} and are not applied if '''Elise''' is {{tip|blind}}.

mechanics.claim: The bonus on-hit damage is applied as proc damage.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|proc damage}} on the bonus magic damage on-hit in ''Spider Form''.
